changes.title: Faster ordinary Settings Back without a scene rebuild
changes.text: Closing ordinary Settings now returns directly to its underlying game or title scene rather than forcing a complete scene reconstruction and font-generator reset every time. Explicit language selection and system-font controls keep their existing authorized reset behavior. This does not claim all unrelated Back routes are faster.
